resources.name: Fletcher (1958) Size effect in heterogeneous nucleation

access.notes: Provides the spherical cap factor f(m,x) used in the heterogeneous nucleation barrier calculation.

resources.name: Physical constants for water/ice as used in the paper

access.notes: Standard values: ice-water interfacial free energy σ=20 erg/cm², density ρ=1 g/cm³, latent heat ΔH_f=3.34e9 erg/g, melting temperature T_m=273 K.
